statement: Suppose A and A′ are isogenous elliptic curves over Q of analytic rank at most one. Then QA # Sha(A/Q) = QA′ # Sha(A′/Q) . In particular X(A) = X(A′). Over a number field, the corresponding analytic-to-arithmetic BSD ratio is likewise invariant under isogeny when the Tate–Shafarevich groups are finite. It is compatible with products and restriction of scalars.
